remarks: Fully renovated and move-in ready, this 3-bedroom home offers approximately 1,700 square feet of thoughtfully updated living space. The interior features a bright, open layout with a brand-new kitchen complete with modern cabinetry, quality countertops, and stainless steel appliances. All major systems have been updated, providing peace of mind and low maintenance for years to come. The home includes three well-sized bedrooms, updated bathrooms with contemporary finishes, and new flooring throughout. Additional improvements include updated electrical, plumbing, HVAC and windows. Outside, enjoy a private yard ideal for entertaining, relaxing, or future expansion. Conveniently located on the Stamford/Greenwich border with easy access to major commuter routes, this home offers both convenience and connectivity to nearby shopping, dining, and amenities. A turnkey opportunity for buyers seeking quality, comfort, and location.  Professional photos to be uploaded.
